source: unite-db.com JSON endpoints (primary); serebii.net per-Pokémon pages (evolution cross-check, Pokémon missing from unite-db)

gameVersion.note: No source states which patch each value reflects; unite-db stores a per-Pokémon "lastUpdated" date instead.

notes: Primary source: unite-db.com/pokemon.json (identity, tags, evolution, moves) and unite-db.com/stats.json (level 1-15 stats). These are the JSON files the unite-db front-end itself loads.
Mega forms and Mewtwo X/Y are separate records, as on unite-db (they have their own stat lines and kits).
boostedAttack.description is unite-db's basic-attack text; boostedAttack.damage holds the boosted-attack formula components.
Pokémon present on Serebii but absent from unite-db are included with dataSource "serebii-only": their stats come from Serebii (HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD only) and fields Serebii does not publish are null.
Jolteon: present on Serebii only (not in unite-db.com/pokemon.json at retrieval time).
Flareon: present on Serebii only (not in unite-db.com/pokemon.json at retrieval time).

units.attackSpeedBonusPct: percent bonus basic-attack speed (unite-db "attack_speed"; not attacks per second)
units.moveSpeed: game movement-speed units as published (e.g. 3650 at level 1 for most Pokémon)
units.penetration: as published by unite-db ("penetration"); unit/type not documented by the source
units.evolution: fromLevel = level at which that stage is reached

pokemon.name: Absol

boostedAttack.description: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals increased damage.
boostedAttack.detailedDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, and decreasing their Defense by 15% for 2s when the attack hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals bonus damage.

pokemon.uniteDbNotes: All of Absol's attacks and damaging moves can critically strike. Absol's Critical-Hit rate increases at levels 5 and 9.

pokemon.name: Aegislash

boostedAttack.description: Slash at enemies in front of Aegislash, dealing damage to them. If the boost count is one or more, basic attacks become a boosted attack. When in Blade Stance: pierce through enemies, dealing damage. When in Shield Stance: ram enemies, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for a short time, restore HP, and reduce the cooldown of Sacred Sword and Shadow Claw when this attack hits. Every boosted attack consumes one boost count. Up to 4 boosted boosted attacks can be stored.
boostedAttack.detailedDescription: When in Sword Forme: slashes at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. When in Shield Forme: rams at opposing Pokémon, damaging those hit. Becomes a boosted attack if the boost count is at 1 or more, consuming 1 boost count; the boosted attack changes based on the current Forme. The boost count caps at 4, and boosted attacks remain readied until used.

damage.label: Damage - Boosted (Additional) (Sword Stance)
damage.description: Deals an additional 8.5% of the enemies Max HP as damage.
damage.notes: Against Wild Pokemon: The additional damage from maximum HP is capped at 1000.

pokemon.uniteDbNotes: Auto attacks, Shadow Claw, and Iron Head (after using Shadow Claw+) can critically strike. While in Shield Stance however, boosted attacks do not critically strike. Aegislash's Critical-Hit rate increases at levels 5 and 9.
